title: SnapSip: the magnetic lid that reseals any can

source.ref: A magnetic, leak-proof lid that snaps onto any standard can and turns it into a resealable travel cup.

walkaway.note: Wants a retail partner; will not take a perpetual royalty.

brief: Consumer product, 14 months on Amazon and own site. $410k trailing-12-month sales, $14.99 retail, $2.10 landed cost, 4.6 stars on 3,900 reviews. Patent pending. Solo founder plus two contractors.
